title: Block Out Level 27 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 27 is a pocket-release boss puzzle. Empty the right cavity first, start lowering the left `7` boss second, and only then clean up the late green, red, and yellow strips.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 27 is a pocket-release boss puzzle. Empty the right cavity first, start lowering the left `7` boss second, and only then clean up the late green, red, and yellow strips.
landmarks: Block Out Level 27 is a pocket-release boss puzzle.
Empty the right cavity first, start lowering the left `7` boss second, and only then clean up the late green, red, and yellow strips.
The board mixes Purple, White, Black and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The right pocket opens the left boss.
The late color strips are post-boss cleanup.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Empty the right white-and-black cavity first.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Lower the left-side counters while the boss is still intact.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Start shrinking the framed `7` panel only after the side pocket is clear.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the newly opened space to rotate the late green and red strips.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Bring the yellow strip in only after the boss is already below mid-count.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the side exits once the boss is nearly gone.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last color strips after the framed panel has collapsed.

failurePoints: Ignoring the right cavity and pulling on the left boss too early.
Treating the late color strips as the opening phase.
